text:
maria.garcia: Heads up — Handshake Bridge (SecureStack) pilot kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. We need a short runbook for SSO + SCIM + KMS integration. @ajay.patel can you bring the connector spec? :calendar:
ajay.patel: Yep — will bring spec + OIDC flow diagram. Also need the exact SCIM attributes they expect (extensions). I can post a sample mapping after lunch.
sasha: Quick note: partner's KMS path expects HSM-backed keys via KMIP. Do we have a supported KMIP flow for Private deployments? @lee_ops
lee_ops: We support customer-managed KMS and HSM connectors in Private. For Hosted we'll do envelope encryption with BYOK and a partner key wrapping step. Legal/crypto signoff needed for BYOK, I'll flag it.
olivia_pm: Pilot goals: 2-week run in eu-west, success = SSO login, SCIM provisioning for ~100 users, KMS rotation with zero-downtime, and secrets sync with their SecretsVault. Anything missing?
maria.garcia: Add telemetry/trace requirements for audits (who provisioned, who rotated keys). Also need a list of endpoints we can expose to partner for their SI to run smoke tests.
partners-bot: Checklist created: https://confluence.redwood/handshake-bridge/checklist (auto-created) :white_check_mark:
ajay.patel: SCIM note — partner requires schema extension for urn:custom:employeeNumber and urn:custom:securityClearance. Sample mapping I’ll paste in kickoff doc. Example mapping snippet: ```scim_mapping = {"userName":"emails[0].value","urn:custom:employeeNumber":"employeeId","urn:custom:securityClearance":"clearance_level"}```
sasha: On HSM adapters: partner HSM vendor exposes PKCS#11. Suggest we scope an "adapter v1" that translates KMIP calls to PKCS#11 for on-prem installs. That keeps Hosted flow untouched.
lee_ops: Action items (owners):
  1) Create partner test tenant + API keys — maria.garcia
  2) KMS/HSM adapter spike — eng-runtime (assign after kickoff)
  3) SCIM mapping doc + test fixtures — ajay.patel
  4) BYOK compliance checklist — legal/crypto (I’ll loop them in)
Deadline: target next Friday for spikes & fixtures.
maria.garcia: I’ll provision the test tenant tonight and share creds in the secure channel. Scheduling note: kickoff invites out in 10m.
olivia_pm: Please add pilot timeline to marketplace launch doc: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/handshake-pilot and tag me.
ajay.patel: Will drop the SCIM sample payload and an initial test harness link in this thread after the meeting.
sasha: Also we should capture rollback story if KMS adapter fails — fallback to partner-managed wrapping key and disable auto-rotate. Add to runbook.
maria.garcia: Good call. I’ll add a rollback step and a signed-owner field for any rotation ops. See you all tomorrow. :thumbsup:
